11.Name: Sheikh Ab. II
11.Player Description: An exchange student at Dice Soccer High, Sheikh Abdullah II's family wealth is partly behind the formation of the Dice Soccer League.

55.Name: McDonaldino
55.Player Description: With a grin that stretches from Brazil to Milan, you just know that he's lovin' it. The DSL couldn't have been happier when the trickster made the switch.
55.Unlock Criteria: Complete 3 Matches in Tournament 2 of Season 2!

12.Name: Marshall Artz
12.Player Description: Marshall is the other exchange student at Dice Soccer High. He is a scheming competitor and will stop at nothing to achieve world domination. And victory.
12.Unlock Criteria: To unlock, Visit the Dice Soccer Federation Authorities and sit through their presentation!

56.Name: Charlie Estevez
56.Player Description: He is winning! The Argentinian star moved into the riches of City and moved out once more to the even greener pastures of the Dice Soccer League.
56.Unlock Criteria: Hoard 5 Million in your bank to unlock!

13.Name: Marc Bullock
13.Player Description: Marc Bullock is a tough contender and is built like an ox. After ending a successful career in Germany, he comes to the Dice Soccer League in search of new horns to lock!
13.Unlock Criteria: Complete 4 Matches in Tournament 1 of Season 1!

57.Name: Pat Cheque
57.Player Description: Pat dives head first into every encounter, and most of the time comes out on top. He's an inspiration to young goalkeepers back home in Prague.
57.Unlock Criteria: Win 1 Match in Tournament 2 of Season 3!

80.Name: Kiki
80.Player Description: What every soccer kid should aspire to be - A star on the field, and a human being off of it. Kiki's a real role model. He's also really expensive.
80.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Win All Matches in Season 3 League!

14.Name: Barney Hulligan
14.Player Description: Formerly a devout and boisterous fan of Footchester United, Dice Soccer gave Barney the chance to make his footballing dreams come true, both on and off the field.
14.Unlock Criteria: Complete 1 Match in the Season 1 League!

58.Name: Ashton Cool
58.Player Description: The iceman is never fazed, always composed in defense. The only time he heats up is when he's left on the bench!
58.Unlock Criteria: Complete 5 Matches in Tournament 2 of Season 2!

81.Name: Dave The Jewel
81.Player Description: This Spaniard's had a rough debut. He's young, agile and eager, and someday might even be as great as the Flying Dutchman.
81.Unlock Criteria: Concede a goal with less than 1:00 on the clock

15.Name: Johnny Speed
15.Player Description: Johnny is Jimmy's first cousin once removed. His unique athleticism in an otherwise pedestrian lineup makes him a difficult target for the opposition to hold down.
15.Unlock Criteria: Complete Match 2 of the Training Season!

59.Name: Jerry Pickaxe
59.Player Description: He's got an axe to grind and you better not be at the wrong end of it. He'll whittle you down before you know it and turn you in to firewood for the New Camp site.
59.Unlock Criteria: Spend 10 million on players and I'll join you!

82.Name: Gabe Ketchup
82.Player Description: Gabe's a saucy competitor. He's fierce on defense and at his age he can still catch up to the fastest of forwards.

16.Name: Jack von Strapp
16.Player Description: Bully. Jock. Prom King. von Strapp has done it all. Now all he would like to do is kick some little kids' rears on the Dice Soccer field.

83.Name: Syrio Romas
83.Player Description: Syrio would like nothing more than to win every trophy by beating his rival New Campers in the final. Let's hope he gets his wish.

17.Name: King Jim
17.Player Description: King Jim has spent many years as goalie for some of England's best teams. With retirement around the corner, Dice Soccer seemed like a good place to spend his time while he continues to collect art.
17.Unlock Criteria: Complete 2 Matches in Tournament 2 of Season 1!

40.Name: Bertie Schweister
40.Player Description: Bertie is a German juggernaught. He'll blitz through your defensive lines faster than he made the switch to the DSL when he heard of its success.
40.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Win 1 Match in Tournament 1 of Season 2!

84.Name: Savio Confetti
84.Player Description: The Argentine captain has years of experience under his belt. Don't cry for him unless you want him to have the last laugh.

18.Name: Bob Zomby
18.Player Description: Bob eats, breathes and lives soccer. And at this rate he'll probably die soccer too. Which makes him a great member of any Dice Soccer team.

41.Name: Papa Raynor
41.Player Description: Raynor's a hard man to beat. It was hard to even convince the Spaniard to leave his club in England to come play in the Dice Soccer League.

85.Name: Rowdy Morales
85.Player Description: Rowdy's not the fairest of players. His morals when it comes to sportsmanship are as reliable as his hairdo and tattoos. He's got a sure foot nonetheless.
85.Unlock Criteria: Be denied a goal with less than 1:00 on the clock

19.Name: Bryan Nelson
19.Player Description: After getting tired of regulation Soccer, Bryan chose to transfer to the DSL rather than go back to his hometown in New Zealand.
19.Unlock Criteria: Complete 2 matches in Tournament 1 of Season 1!

42.Name: Mason
42.Player Description: Mason. One word that strikes fear into the hearts of even the heartiest of strikers. They've been known to freeze in their tracks at just the sight of him.

86.Name: Drogo Militante
86.Player Description: If you want someone who can run like a horse, this is your man. Fast, furious and dogged in his pursuit, Drogo will seldom disappoint.
86.Unlock Criteria: Score a goal with less than 1:00 on the clock

43.Name: Dani Always
43.Player Description: Dani left the New Camp just recently when heard that a new league was forming. He's reliable, relentless and rearing to go!

87.Name: Robin Horde
87.Player Description: He'll score against the rich and the poor alike. He's come all the way from Brazil and he plans to take no prisoners. Watch out!

44.Name: Loco
44.Player Description: Loco. Another name that drives forwards up the wall. When he and Mason combine, prepare for a Samba lockdown.
44.Unlock Criteria: Complete 3 Matches in Tournament 1 of Season 2!

88.Name: Derry Cute
88.Player Description: He's the new sweetheart of Lillypool team, or so he'd like to believe. Ever since his partner Toro left for bluer pastures, all eyes have been on Derry!

45.Name: Cesar Fabulas
45.Player Description: He's a hard worker and a born leader. A rare Spaniard who made a living in England, he chose the DSL over going back to his home in the New Camp.
45.Unlock Criteria: Complete 5 Matches in Tournament 1 of Season 2!

89.Name: Faith Uno
89.Player Description: If you believe in Faith, she will never fail to deliver. She's anchored the American women's team many a time, with great performances in goal.

46.Name: Dmitri Bubbletop
46.Player Description: His laconian playing style is reminiscent of his humble Bulgarian origins. But his predatory skills live up to those of the deadliest of red devils.
46.Unlock Criteria: Unlock Players 17-32 and I'll be yours!

47.Name: Sammy Uatu'u
47.Player Description: Uatu'u is a watcher. And a waiter. His career isn't ending - it's just beginning to roll!
47.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Score 7 Goals in a game!

70.Name: El Toro
70.Player Description: El Toro was one of the most expensive players bought by an English club - just before he ran into a spell of bad luck. Maybe the DSL can help him fix that?

48.Name: Manual Automator
48.Player Description: The Automator, is a goal scoring machine. And from England to Spain to the DSL, he just won't stop rolling in the goals.
48.Unlock Criteria: Earn 119 Stars or buy him real cheap while you can!

71.Name: Hugo Gonzalez
71.Player Description: Gonzo, as he is known, loves finding the back of the net. But sometimes it can also be a pain in the neck.
71.Unlock Criteria: Win 1 Match in Tournament 1 of Season 3

49.Name: Hector Hernandez
49.Player Description: The goals don't come easy when he's on duty. He's got matador blood running in his veins. Ole!

72.Name: Dido Dropbear
72.Player Description: He'll pounce at you out of nowhere and score without a word. From Ivory Coast to London, he's a force to reckon.
72.Unlock Criteria: Unlock all players from 49-64 and I'll join you too!

73.Name: Ikea Quesadillas
73.Player Description: He's not swedish nor mexican, but a salt of the earth Spaniard. And he'll protect his dice-goal just like he does in Madrid.
73.Unlock Criteria: Qualify for Season 4 to get me!

30.Name: Wiley Sniper
30.Player Description: He's a cunning ol' coyote, he is. Give him even half a chance and he'll take it away from you and finish in style. There's no going dutch with this Dutchman!
30.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Win all matches of Season 1 League!

74.Name: Carlos The Wall
74.Player Description: Carlos puts the Mad in Madrid, when he plays against his archrivals. But the DSL is a place for new alliances to be formed.
74.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, roll a total of 90 or more!

31.Name: Sammy Nazareth
31.Player Description: This French messiah was making all the transfer headlines in England before he decided to join the exodus and become a part of the DSL.
31.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, finish 10 matches in a draw!

75.Name: Theo Fernando
75.Player Description: With the twist of a shoulder Theo can turn a scoring chance into an offside trap. When he teams up with Narnia, it's improbable to score.
75.Unlock Criteria: Complete 3 Matches in Tournament 1 of Season 3!

32.Name: Blanc Bribery
32.Player Description: Beware of Blanc! The Frenchman is a big threat in the German leagues and will rob you of your possession in broad daylight if you don't watch him like a hawk.

76.Name: Jean Terrible
76.Player Description: Having Jean on the field is a terrible idea. For the opposition! Though he leads from the back, there's no affrontery that he won't spare you.
76.Unlock Criteria: Win Tournament 3.2 and I'll join you.

33.Name: Twin Powered
33.Player Description: This All-American is tall, strong, and quick; he's good enough to even be a striker! He'll have you seeing stars and stripes if you try and score!
33.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, make the enemy roll a Zero total!

77.Name: Caliente Rollovo
77.Player Description: Caliente loves attention. Especially female attention. And he knows how to get it. He'll dribble and dive his way past enemy lines, and finish in style.
77.Unlock Criteria: Earn 120 Stars or buy him real cheap while you can!

34.Name: Glee Cliche
34.Player Description: He might seem like just another Pro footballer trying to cash in on the DSL mania, but Glee's no song and dance - he's got what it takes!
34.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Roll a 40 or more!

78.Name: Vain Looney
78.Player Description: Looney's a loose cannon! He puts his foot in mouth as often as he put its it goal. He's a hard hitter, so make sure you have him set in a good position!
78.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Win all matches in Season 2 League!

35.Name: Zachary Santa
35.Player Description: Don't be fooled by the name - he's not giving away any presents this year, especially if you've been nice! He'll tackle you hard and won't even apologize after.
35.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, roll a total of 30 or more!

79.Name: La Messy
79.Player Description: The game is most beautiful when it's Messy. The irony is not lost on this poet with a powershot. You can lift your jaw off the floor now.
79.Unlock Criteria: Complete 3 Matches in Tournament 2 of Season 3!

36.Name: Kello the Tourist
36.Player Description: He may look like he's here for the sights and sounds, but he'll blindside you with tight marking. His brother Yoyo is rumored to be interested in the DSL too.
36.Unlock Criteria: Complete 4 Matches in the Season 2 League

60.Name: Narnia Villish
60.Player Description: You'll never know where the ball lands up if you try running past the fearsome Narnia from Serbia. His favorite color is red and he's seen it plenty of times too.
60.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Roll a total of 60 or more!

37.Name: Franklin Leinhart
37.Player Description: Good 'ol Franky was a stalwart back at Cheesy FC, before they lost the league and cleaned house. Good thing the DSL was growing up and looking for experienced players!

61.Name: Andrew Fiesta
61.Player Description: Andy was one of the first few heavyweight world-class players to have left their own leagues in favor of the DSL. This is hopefully the start of a positive trend for the competition.

38.Name: Toby van Mercy
38.Player Description: The assassin from the Netherlands is here to stake his claim on the DSL title. Young and full of vigor, he's a sucker for a well placed offside trap.
38.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, concede 3 goals in one game!

62.Name: Neo Ballcop
62.Player Description: He's a firebrand, and he's the future of soccer. The DSL couldn't have asked for a better posterboy to join their ranks to promote the game to more youngsters out there.

39.Name: Andy Robin
39.Player Description: He's no sidekick. He'll kick it square in the ball. And score. Coz that's the Oranje way.
39.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, complete 12 Matches in Season 2's League!

63.Name: Zoltron Abrams
63.Player Description: Zolton's won more tournaments with more teams than anyone can keep track of. Time to add to the silverware with DSL trophies!
63.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, score 5 goals in a single game!

20.Name: Latent Paines
20.Player Description: Latent Paines is a solid defender who can bring a snowballing attack to a complete standstill. Just make sure you roll what he needs!
20.Unlock Criteria: Complete 4 Matches in Tournament 2 of Season 1!

64.Name: David Chateau
64.Player Description: With half his team quitting and joining the DSL, David has an easy choice: retire to his Spanish villa, or complete his destiny with dice.
64.Unlock Criteria: Unlock Players 33-48 and you'll get me too!

21.Name: Steve Jeopardy
21.Player Description: Stevie J is a living legend, a hero in his hometown of Lillypool, and now he's come to make another name for himself in the Dice Soccer League that's quickly gathering momentum!
21.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Roll a total of 20 or more!

65.Name: Flying Dutchman
65.Player Description: At the age of 40, he's still one of the best goalies in the world. Willy could learn a thing or two from him now that he's retiring from the Diablos.
65.Unlock Criteria: Win 50 Matches if you want me!

22.Name: Ray Beeze
22.Player Description: Ray is the kinda player who's always hungry for the ball. But his bark can often be worse than his bite. Make sure his ponytail is wagging!
22.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Roll a total of 0!

66.Name: Jeremy Carrier
66.Player Description: He's a fighter. And he battles with concussive force. Which he can sometimes be at the receiving end of. But he's a fighter nonetheless.
66.Unlock Criteria: Roll a total of 70 or more!

23.Name: Antonio Lucacci
23.Player Description: This Italian stallion will give you a run for your money. His ability to turn a game on its head makes him an asset to any team!

0.Comments: Referee (offside, offside, yellow card, red card, blank, blank)

67.Name: Ivan Brainovic
67.Player Description: Another Serb who enjoys the appeal of playing soccer with dice, Ivan was a key member of his former unit back at Cheesy FC.
67.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Roll a total of 100 or more!

1.Name: Willy the Kid
1.Player Description: Though the big kids will only let him play goalie, Willy's always wanted to be a soccer star. What he lacks in size, he'll make up in heart.

24.Name: Solo Kilo
24.Player Description: From the Ivorian coasts comes Solo Kilo, leading the waves of Pro footballers who are taking kindly towards this new form of the sport!
24.Unlock Criteria: Score 3 goals in a single game!

90.Name: Crystal Rampage
90.Player Description: This Crystal is far from delicate. Even the boys think twice about crossing the ball when she's around.

2.Name: Earnest Mulligan
2.Player Description: Sport might not be his forte, but he'll put mind over matter if his best friend Willy needs him. Always of assistance, Ernie is great at getting you out of a bad roll.

68.Name: Jorges Beinsilli
68.Player Description: Jorges loves wearing black and white stripes and is one of the few Italians in the league currently. Can you help him find a matching kit?
68.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, roll a total of 80 or more!

91.Name: Carl Darkhorse
91.Player Description: The captain of the Spanglers is a true leader, inspiring skeptical fans to think twice before writing of Dice Soccer as a real sport.

3.Name: Jo Lee-Roger
3.Player Description: Josephine may look like the typical girl next door, but this tomboy packs a mean tackle! Especially if you call her by her real name!

25.Name: Jolly Kaisaro
25.Player Description: The Brazilian Custodian, as he is commonly called, finds goalkeeping with dice a little easier on the knees than his previous assignment.
25.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, roll a total of 50 or more!

4.Name: Sherman 'Tank'
4.Player Description: Sherman is the local thug who'll always get you out of a spot before he gets into one. So when Willy needed an extra defender on his DSL team, his older brother was happy to oblige.

69.Name: Footy Spice
69.Player Description: Footy Spice is the glam king of the sport. When he joined the DSL, custom dice with his number imprinted sold like British pop records.

26.Name: Davy Loose
26.Player Description: Dave Loose just completed an expensive transfer to one of England's top clubs. But even they couldn't keep him for long, once the appeal of the DSL grew.

5.Name: Randy Johnson
5.Player Description: Randy is completely nuts! And winning is not the only STREAK he's crazy about. Better to have him on your team than on theirs! Look out for those exhibition matches.

92.Name: Mickey Coachson
92.Player Description: The game runs in his blood! While his father coaches the national team, Mickey's busy doing his club and country proud, patriotic to the very core.

93.Name: Lauretta Chancy
93.Player Description: There's no lucky breaks with this gal from Indianapolis. Her goals get the ball rolling, and her assists will win matches.
93.Unlock Criteria: Win All League Matches in Season 4

6.Name: David Little
6.Player Description: Don't judge David by his acne and braces. This giant-killer can pack quite the punch when deployed behind enemy lines. Underestimate him at your own peril!

27.Name: Jen Glonson
27.Player Description: Jen is a dogged defender, and his former Lillypool team-mates will defend that. But rolling in the grass is so much more fun when you're dice, isn't it?
27.Unlock Criteria: I'll be available once you unlock players 1-16!

50.Name: Ricky Cavalier
50.Player Description: Rick's always up to his tricks in the locker room. But on the field, he's as steady as a rock. Just don't let him get you Rick-rolled.
50.Unlock Criteria: Earn 118 Stars or buy him real cheap while you can!

7.Name: Justin Huff
7.Player Description: A true lover of the game, and always ready to fight for the underdogs, Justin brings much needed post-pubescent height to the starting lineup.

94.Name: Alice Hogan
94.Player Description: Don't underestimate America's sweetheart. Once they opened up the league to women, she was the first in and has never looked back since.
94.Unlock Criteria: Qualify for Season 5 with at least 30 stars in Season 4

8.Name: Jerry Hat-trick
8.Player Description: Jerry was once the greatest striker in all of football. Though age has since caught up with him, he still has a trick or two up his sleeve.
8.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, Complete all Training matches!!

28.Name: Tommy Vermillion
28.Player Description: Tommy loves obscure shades of red and orange. But don't get distracted - this Belgian defender will break intercept your blitz!
28.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, survive the infamous Chancy FC!

51.Name: Pete Everlast
51.Player Description: The former French skipper loves turning a good contest on its head, and has had plenty of them in his time with the Diablos. The DSL better watch out!
51.Unlock Criteria: Lose 10 Matches and I'll come to your aid!

9.Name: Jose Heartbreak
9.Player Description: He's been known to let a few in from time to time, but now that he's moved out of the City, he's set on getting rid of his blues.
9.Unlock Criteria: To Unlock, concede zero goals in one game!!

95.Name: Annie Winback
95.Player Description: She's got he wind in her sails and doesn't look like she'll be stopping any time soon. Annie leads from the front and scores the crucial winning goals.
95.Unlock Criteria: Win the First Tournament of Season 4

29.Name: Three Lung Park
29.Player Description: Doctors have concluded that the only explanation behind the Korean star's stamina and endurance is that he was born with an extra lung.
29.Unlock Criteria: Win 1 Match in Tournament 2 of Season 2!

52.Name: Paulse Alarm
52.Player Description: The German skipper gave up his national responsibilities just so that he could transfer to the promising and lucrative DSL. Surely he made the right choice?

96.Name: Orlando Donahue
96.Player Description: The poster boy for American soccer, he's played at every level of the game and is now bringing his talents to an all new contest to conquer.
96.Unlock Criteria: Win the Second Tournament of Season 4

53.Name: Dryin' Legs
53.Player Description: Luck is temporary, class is permanent. 'Ol Legsy has been tearing it up since 1991 and continues to ravage and plunder even in the DSL.

10.Name: Linus Backer
10.Player Description: Linus Backer was born to play football. Unfortunately, a slight mixup with his athletic scholarship drafted him into the wrong kind of football program.
10.Unlock Criteria: Complete 6 Matches in the Season 1 League!

54.Name: Teri Handry
54.Player Description: Teri prefers a much more hands-on approach to the game than other players. The DSL provides the Frenchman with one more chance to salvage his career.
54.Unlock Criteria: Hoard 2 Million in your bank to unlock!
